excerpt.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，我们的科研船的船员报告了奇怪的干扰：内心深处藏着疯狂的幻境，一种被持续监视的感觉，断断续续的幻觉……

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，我们的科研船的船员报告了奇怪的干扰：内心深处藏着疯狂的幻境，一种被持续监视的感觉，断断续续的幻觉……

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
texts.en:
Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, and the crew of our science vessel reports strange disturbances: wildly visceral dreamlike visions, a persistent sense of being watched, fitful hallucinations...

Despite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a tunnel through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]星系中潜藏着什么东西：从时空织构中裂出的一个隐秘通道，它的视界泛着灵能的涟漪。探测器的数据飘忽不定，但蜂巢已经被扰动了。一种被监视的感觉始终萦绕着我们，这是一种独特的感觉，似乎某物正在隧道的大口另一侧向我们袭来。

尽管我们很可惜地缺乏有效的遥测手段，但似乎很显然，我们偶然发现了一条通向未知事物的隧道。这是一条危险的路径，但回报可能非常丰厚；在隧道的另一端则连接着星系中一个非常遥远的角落。
texts.en:
Something waits in the [From.GetName] system: a veiled passage, cut from the fabric of spacetime, its horizon rippling with psionic energy. Sensor data is erratic, but the hive has been disturbed. A persistent feeling of being watched pervades us, the distinct sense that something looms just beyond the tunnel's mouth.

Despite the frustrating lack of useful telemetry, it seems clear we have stumbled on a passage through uncharted reaches. A dangerous path, yet the rewards may be great; on the tunnel's far side lies a distant corner of the galaxy.

label.zh: 面纱后面隐藏着什么秘密？
label.en: What mysteries lie beyond the veil?

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次进入有虚境隧道的星系时触发（on_entering_system_first_time，00_on_actions.txt:930），“虚境学徒”起源与已自建隧道的帝国除外。隧道总枢纽随虚境行者城邦星系生成（overlord_initializers.txt:595），各地节点由虚境信标产生（enclave_effects.txt:510）。
notes.en: Review note: fires on first entering a system with a Shroud Tunnel (on_entering_system_first_time, 00_on_actions.txt:930), except for the Shroudwalker Apprentice origin and empires that built their own tunnel. The tunnel nexus is spawned with the Shroudwalker enclave system (overlord_initializers.txt:595); local nodes come from Shroud Beacons (enclave_effects.txt:510).

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了剧烈的变化。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
texts.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]令人担忧的发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了一个令人恐慌的转变。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
texts.en: Alarming developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a horrifying transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]令人担忧的发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官发生了剧烈的变化。虽然无人机的性格矩阵和神经突触模式没有受到影响，但其物理形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个生物物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
texts.en: Alarming developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While the drone's personality-matrix and neuro-synaptic patterns remain largely unaffected, its physical form has been dramatically altered. It now has the aspect (and internal organs) of a biological species.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官发生了剧烈的变化。虽然集体记忆没有受到影响，但工蜂的物理形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。其现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
texts.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While our collective memories remain unaffected, the drone's physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的奇怪发育：穿过虚境隧道后，舰队指挥官经历了剧烈的变化。虽然其性格和记忆没有受到影响，但身体形态已经发生了剧烈的变化。舰队指挥官现在拥有了一个完全陌生物种的外貌（和内部器官）。
texts.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after passing through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has undergone a rapid transformation. While their personality and memories remain unaffected, their physical form has been dramatically altered. They now have the aspect (and internal organs) of an entirely alien species.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，舰队指挥官报告他们经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。他们的心里充满着一些“可能是从别处来的”想法。很明显，有什么事情发生了，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
texts.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after their recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the fleet commander has reported the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions. Their mind is buzzing with ideas that 'might have come from someone else.' It seems clear that something has happened, perhaps as a result of contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud. How this experience will affect their performance remains to be seen...

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分奇怪：在他们最近穿过虚境甬道之后，我们的集体意识遭到了微妙的改变，这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后产生的后果。指挥子个体报告经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪，他们的心里充满着一些新想法。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
texts.en: Strange developments on the [Root.GetName]: after its passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered, perhaps as a result of the psionic energy of the Shroud. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and emotions, their mind buzzing with new ideas. It remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的进展十分反常：在舰船最近穿过虚境甬道之后，我们的集体意识遭到了微妙的改变。指挥子个体报告经历了一股不熟悉的感觉和情绪。这很有可能是同虚境的灵能能量进行接触后，它们的神经网络受到了影响。这样的经历会怎样影响他们的战斗效能我们尚且未知……
texts.en: Abnormal developments on the [Root.GetName]: after the vessel's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, our collective consciousness has been subtly altered. The command drone reports the experience of unfamiliar sensations and ideations. It is possible that contact with the psionic energy of the Shroud has affected their neural network, although it remains to be seen how this experience will affect their performance.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种心理上的改变现在显现了出来：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，此人的指挥风格发生了显著的变化。现在我们可以说，这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
texts.en: The subtle mental changes experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into focus: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their command style has noticeably shifted. It is fair to say that the experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种神经上的改变现在影响到了集体意识：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，子个体的排列模式发生了显著的变化。这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
texts.en: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now coming into collective focus: a month after the drone's passage through the Shroud Tunnel, their disposition has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的指挥官所经历的那种神经上的改变现在显现了出来：在穿过虚境甬道一个月之后，子个体的人格矩阵发生了显著的变化。这股经历现在演变发展成了一个新的特质。
texts.en: The neural changes first experienced by the commander of the [Root.GetName] are now becoming clear: a month after their passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the drone's personality matrix has noticeably shifted. The experience has resulted in the development of a new trait.

texts.zh: 由于最近通向了虚境甬道，[Root.GetName]上的系统开始出现奇怪的行为：舰船日志上的条目随机显示；有人看到房门不断地开关；此外——更令人忧心的是——引擎的遏止力场出现了波动。到目前为止，所有试图溯源这些问题的努力都告失败。
texts.en: After its recent passage through the Shroud Tunnel, the systems on the [Root.GetName] began behaving strangely: entries in the ships log are displayed at random; doors have been observed opening and closing; and - far more worrisome - the engine's containment field has begun to fluctuate. So far, efforts to track down the source of the problem have proven futile.

texts.zh:
科研船[Root.GetName]上出现了奇怪的进展：引擎的遏止力场内出现了重复的模式，这表明存在一个人造的意识。由于这个意识是在船只的系统和虚境的灵能能量进行交互的过程中产生的，它目前还处于一种梦境的状态。类似于某些物种在睡眠时会出现的快眼运动，造成舰船一部分功能失常的原因正是这个实体的神经活动。

更难以置信的是，我们的调查似乎已经将其唤醒。这个实体希望能够继续栖居在船只的系统内，作为交换，它同意为我们工作。理论上，这样的合作关系可以在很多方面改善[Root.GetName]的运行。
texts.en:
Strange developments on the science vessel [Root.GetName]: a repeating pattern observed within the engine's containment field has revealed the existence of an artificial consciousness. Spawned by the interaction between the ship's systems and the psionic energy of the Shroud, until now it has existed in a dreamlike state. Analogous to the Rapid Eye Movement some species experience during sleep, the entity's neural processes were responsible for the malfunctions affecting ship performance.

Even more incredible, our investigations appear to have awoken it. In exchange for continued habitation within the ship's systems, the entity has agreed to work for us. In theory, a partnership could improve many of the [Root.GetName]'s operations.

texts.zh: 我们最近在虚境隧道穿越的时候在时空中造成了一个巨大的裂口。前所未有的能级的灵能能量从恒星系中喷涌而出……然后汇聚在一起。传感器数据在涨落，激变，但是它看上去正逐渐成为某种虚境生物。庞大，而且肯定富有侵略性。
texts.en: Our recent trip through the Shroud Tunnel has precipitated a massive breach in spacetime. Psionic energy at unprecedented levels is spilling out into the system and... It has begun to coalesce. Sensor data is fluctuating, erratic, but it appears to be some form of Shroud spawn. Large, and definitely aggressive.

label.en: The galaxy grows ever more dangerous.

label.zh: 我们应当将它碾碎成尘。
label.en: We shall grind it into dust.

label.zh: 如果可能的话，我们要避免任何冲突。
label.en: If possible, we will avoid any conflict.

texts.zh: 在黑暗中挣扎了很长一段时间之后，虚境的面纱被揭开了。虽然我们的科学家对虚境信标运作的奇异过程仍然知之甚少，但它的物理系统似乎与灵能纠缠在一起，它的运作几乎像一个活的有机体。它生成的隧道与其说是路线，不如说是近道，为我们的舰船提供了一条通过虚境的超维度捷径。星际探索如今将变得更快……而且更神秘得多。
texts.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Although the strange processes by which the Shroud Beacon functions remain little understood by our scientists, its physical systems appear entangled with psionic energy, its operations almost like those of a living organism. The Tunnel it spawns is more bypass than route, offering our vessels an extradimensional shortcut via the Shroud. Interstellar exploration will now be quicker... and infinitely more mysterious.

notes.zh: 审阅注：建成从虚境行者处购得许可的“虚境信标”恒星基地建筑时触发（00_starbase_buildings.txt:1185）。
notes.en: Review note: fires when the Shroud Beacon starbase building, licensed from the Shroudwalkers, is completed (00_starbase_buildings.txt:1185).

texts.zh: 随着虚境信标的下线，我们失去了进入虚境甬道网络的通行权。除非信标得以替换，否则我们的舰队不能利用网络。
texts.en: With our Shroud Beacon offline, we have lost access to the Shroud Tunnel network. Our fleets will be unable to utilize the network until the Beacon is replaced.
